I am weighing whether the $50 premium is worth closing the deal. Without North Carolina, p4 could trade it or hold it as a permanent blocker. Player one has a dangerous orange setup and could monopolize that color if they acquire New York Avenue. I need cash to block them, but after the trade I can only afford one of the two remaining unowned properties without income. The $50 difference between $625 and $600 is a minor cushion against small rent payments, not a major strategic advantage.

A counter at $600 is the right move. It signals a final offer and avoids dragging the exchange further. The opponent already understands the strategic value of the green set, so they may not accept much lower. If they refuse, I can accept $625 or walk.
